description: Jejak audit wajib untuk setiap kontribusi AI. Format kanonis ditetapkan Orchestrator (menggantikan format lama CREATED BY ... LOCOMO SIGNATURE).
canonical_format: File generated by <Tool>, and Orchestrated by Ronald Poetra (Zaid) last updated at <timestamp ISO-8601 + zona>

examples.python: # File generated by OpenClaw, and Orchestrated by Ronald Poetra (Zaid) last updated at 2026-09-15T19:40:00+07:00
examples.php: /* File generated by AntiGravity, and Orchestrated by Ronald Poetra (Zaid) last updated at 2026-09-15T19:40:00+07:00 */
examples.html: <!-- File generated by Cursor, and Orchestrated by Ronald Poetra (Zaid) last updated at 2026-09-15T19:40:00+07:00 -->

rules.constraint: Gunakan narasi kanonis: 'File generated by <Tool>, and Orchestrated by Ronald Poetra (Zaid) last updated at <timestamp ISO-8601 + zona>'. Bungkus dengan komentar sesuai bahasa (lihat comment_styles). Contoh Python: '# File generated by OpenClaw, and Orchestrated by Ronald Poetra (Zaid) last updated at 2026-09-15T19:40:00+07:00'.

Wajib ada di baris paling atas untuk file baru. Perbarui timestamp (last updated at) setiap modifikasi. Jangan diduplikasi jika sudah ada. Format lama 'CREATED BY ... LOCOMO SIGNATURE' DINYATAKAN TIDAK BERLAKU dan wajib dimigrasi saat file disentuh.
Nama orchestrator tetap 'Ronald Poetra (Zaid)' kecuali User memerintahkan lain secara eksplisit.
